primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Uzziah the king was a leper to the day of his death, and lived in a separate house, being a leper; for he was cut off from the LORD’s house. Jotham his son was over the king’s house, judging the people of the land.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: So Uzziah slept with his fathers; and they buried him with his fathers in the field of burial which belonged to the kings, for they said, “He is a leper.” Jotham his son reigned in his place.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Jotham was twenty-five years old when he began to reign, and he reigned sixteen years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Jerushah the daughter of Zadok.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: So Jotham became mighty, because he ordered his ways before the LORD his God.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Now the rest of the acts of Jotham, and all his wars and his ways, behold, they are written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah.

primaryTextRead.textualBasisJa: 固定WEB本文で名前・父子/系譜/明確な照応を確認。
primaryTextRead.text: Jotham slept with his fathers, and they buried him in David’s city; and Ahaz his son reigned in his place.
